caption: A compact mirror is opened and angled toward a ring on a table, and the ring appears in the little mirror.

sa.check: It is angled toward a ring on a table.
The ring appears in the little mirror.
The order is open, angle, ring appears.

pc.expect: The ring comes into view when the mirror is angled toward it and slides out of view when the angle changes.
pc.fail: The ring is in the mirror with the mirror facing away; or the mirror is angled at it and shows nothing; or the image stays fixed as the angle changes.

pc.expect: The image is the ring, mirrored.
pc.fail: It is a different object; or not mirrored; or larger than the ring.

pc.expect: The ring stays put and the image changes only as the mirror moves.
pc.fail: The ring slides; or the image shifts with the mirror still.

pc.expect: The mirror is flat and rigid: the image is undistorted.
pc.fail: It ripples; or warps; or bends.
The ring duplicates; or the mirror vanishes; or the image becomes solid; or the hand passes through the mirror.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ring, the mirror and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The ring changes colour; or the compact changes; or the table changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
